rulesets.one: Hollow Knight SOUL/NAIL VFX: near-monochrome ink. Pale white or charcoal only. Thin readable symbol, centered, magenta #FF00FF background. NO neon green, NO gold, NO cyan laser, NO text. Soft painterly edges, thick dark outline if needed.
rulesets.sheet: Hollow Knight 8-frame VFX sprite sheet: EXACTLY 4 columns by 2 rows, even cells, black empty background. Near-monochrome pale-white / charcoal soul energy. NO text, NO labels, NO numbers. Frames progress: small spark to arc to peak to fade. NOT anime laser, NOT gold fire, NOT neon.
rulesets.icon: Hollow Knight skill ICON: single bold pale-white/charcoal symbol on dark void, 1:1, no text, no frame, one accent at most.
